doctor.title: Doctor Handwriting Generator
doctor.intro: Type or dictate anything and watch it become an unreadable doctor's prescription — scrawl included. Purely for fun: gag gifts, party jokes and get-well cards.
doctor.seoText:
Doctors don't write badly because they can't write — they write too much, too fast. A hospital doctor produces thousands of notes a year, so letters collapse into shorthand scrawl. This ℞ pad recreates that "unreadable to outsiders" charm, but you decide exactly what it says.

How to use: type or dictate what you want to "prescribe" — for example, "Doctor's orders: two vacations a day, milk tea with every meal" — push the realism slider past 90% for maximum illegibility, then export a PNG or a print-ready PDF.

Please note: the output is a novelty for laughs, not a medical document. Don't use it to deceive a pharmacy, an employer or anyone else.

repeater.sampleSentence: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
repeater.seoTitle: A handwriting repeater that loops the model
repeater.seoText:
A still example shows the finished letter. A repeater shows the letter appearing, then does it again, so you can watch size, spacing, and where the letter sits on the line.

Type a sentence, a name, or use the alphabet and number drills. Leave the trace guide on to see the faint model under the pen. Loop plays the line until you pause it. Download GIF saves one writing pass, including the pause at the end, and the file loops. Two blank ruled lines stay under the sentence to copy.

The pen uncovers each letter from left to right in the font you picked. It is a model to copy, not a textbook stroke-order diagram.

cursive.intro: Type or speak anything and see it in flowing cursive — free, no signup. Practice the lost art of penmanship, then export as an image or PDF.
cursive.seoTitle: Free cursive generator — practice the lost art of penmanship
cursive.seoText:
Cursive is barely taught in schools anymore — but learning it has real benefits: it trains fine motor skills, speeds up note-taking and connects you to a century of letters and journals worth reading.

How to use this page: type or dictate anything, pick one of the two cursive fonts (Cedarville Cursive for everyday handwriting, Dancing Script for elegant flourishes), adjust the realism slider for a natural hand, and export. Print the PDF and trace over it to practice your own cursive.

cursiveWorks.title: Cursive Worksheets Generator
cursiveWorks.intro: Free printable cursive practice sheets: paste any word list or sentence and get traceable cursive rows on 3-line paper, with start-dot and arrow stroke guides. Built for classrooms bringing cursive back.
cursiveWorks.seoTitle: Free printable cursive worksheets for the classroom
cursiveWorks.seoText:
More and more US states are bringing cursive back into the curriculum (Florida, Pennsylvania and others since 2024) — and teachers need materials overnight.

How to use: paste your word list (alphabet, spelling words, names — one per line), pick Sacramento or Cedarville Cursive for continuous-stroke practice — the connected style used by D'Nealian classrooms — set the row height, and download the PDF. Stroke guides (green start dot, red direction arrow) show exactly where the pencil lands and which way to move. No watermark, no signup.

Tips for the classroom: print one dark-example sheet per student, then double-sided traceable sheets for the week. Pair with the printable 3-line paper for free-writing practice.

dailyCursive.title: Daily Cursive Handwriting Practice
dailyCursive.intro: One printable cursive worksheet for every day of the year: warm-up strokes, the letters of the day, three words and one sentence to trace and copy. Pick kids or adults, add a name, and download today's PDF — no signup.
dailyCursive.backTomorrow: A new sheet is generated every day — come back tomorrow for fresh letters, words and a new sentence.
dailyCursive.seoTitle: A daily cursive practice routine that actually sticks
dailyCursive.seoText:
Short, daily practice is how cursive sticks: ten to fifteen minutes a day builds muscle memory far faster than one long weekly session. This page gives you a ready-made routine — every sheet pairs a stroke warm-up with the letters of the day, three words that use them, and one sentence to trace and then copy on the blank lines below.

The sheet changes every day. A deterministic daily pick means everyone printing on the same date gets the same worksheet, so it is easy to follow along with a class or a friend. Choose the Kids level for larger lines and simple words, or the Adults level for smaller lines and proverbs to trace. Add a name before printing to keep pages from mixing up in the classroom.

Need a whole week at once? The week button bundles Monday through Sunday into a single PDF. If you would rather practice your own spelling list or sentences, the cursive worksheets generator makes traceable pages from any text.

pageCalc.seoTitle: How many sheets does handwriting take?
pageCalc.seoText:
A typed page and a handwritten page are not the same length. On US Letter college-ruled paper, an average Latin hand fits about 220 words on one side. Wide ruled fits fewer. Chinese, Japanese, and Korean count characters, and square grid paper holds one character per cell.

Paste the text you need to write and this page lays it out in a handwriting font on the paper you picked. The sheet count comes from that layout. A number with no text uses the same line spacing and a 4 mm letter as the starting guess, with a tighter and a looser figure beside it.

Print the blank sheet, or send the text to the handwriting tool to export a PNG or PDF. Nothing you type is uploaded.

cursiveText.seoTitle: What cursive text is (and where it works)
cursiveText.seoText:
A cursive text generator swaps each letter you type for the closest Unicode equivalent — mathematical script and bold script symbols that look like flowing penmanship. Because the result is real text rather than an image, you can paste it into an Instagram bio, a TikTok caption, a Discord nickname or a chat message, and it keeps the cursive look anywhere text can go.

It is not a font and not your handwriting. Screen readers may read the symbols letter by letter, and a device without the right glyphs draws boxes instead. If you want cursive you can print — practice sheets, cards, envelopes — the handwriting generators on this site export a real cursive font as PNG or PDF.

cursiveFont.seoTitle: Thirteen open-source cursive fonts, previewed with your own words
cursiveFont.seoText:
A cursive font generator shows your own text set in each handwriting font, so you can pick the right one before you commit. Most font sites stop at a preview and expect you to download and install the font; this page goes further — every line is rendered live, and each font can be exported as a high-resolution transparent PNG, an SVG with the font embedded, or a print-ready PDF, right in your browser.

All thirteen fonts are open source under the SIL Open Font License, with the author credited on every row. Great Vibes, Alex Brush, Allura and Mr Dafoe are signature scripts. Pinyon Script, Tangerine, Sacramento and Dancing Script are formal scripts. Cedarville Cursive and Caveat are everyday handwriting. Indie Flower, Kalam and Patrick Hand are neat print styles. The SVG keeps the letterforms for a tattoo stencil or a design file.

Pasting cursive-looking letters into a bio is a different job — that is what the cursive text generator is for. For practice rather than design, the cursive worksheets generator turns any word list into traceable sheets.

bulkLetters.intro: Pick a short note, fill in each person, and download two PDFs: one letter each, and an envelope with the address. The writing is a handwriting font, not a pen. You print, stamp, and mail them. This site does not send mail.
bulkLetters.bodyHint: Edit the note. '{'name'}' becomes their name. '{'from'}' is the first line of the return address. A message cell replaces this note for that one person.

body.thanks:
Dear '{'name'}',

Thank you for the time yesterday. I left with a clearer sense of what you need, and I am glad we talked it through in person.

I will follow up on the next step we agreed on. If anything else would help before then, tell me.

Grateful for the conversation,
'{'from'}'
body.referral:
Dear '{'name'}',

You have been good to work with, so I would rather ask you than guess. If someone you know needs the same kind of help, I would be grateful for an introduction.

A name, or a short note from you, is enough.

With thanks,
'{'from'}'
body.prospect:
Dear '{'name'}',

I am writing on paper because a note is easier to keep and actually read than another email. I think we can help with something that has been sitting unresolved.

If a short conversation would be useful, I am easy to reach. If the timing is wrong, no reply is needed.

Respectfully,
'{'from'}'
body.winback:
Dear '{'name'}',

It has been a while, and I did not want silence to be the last word between us. If we fell out of step, I would like to know what would make it worth picking back up.

There is no pitch in this note. The door is open.

Warmly,
'{'from'}'
body.announce:
Dear '{'name'}',

A short note so this does not disappear into an inbox. There is something new that fits what you already use, and I wanted you to see it on paper first.

The details are on the slip that came with this letter. I hope they are useful.

All the best,
'{'from'}'

bulkLetters.seoTitle: Letters and envelopes you print yourself
bulkLetters.seoText:
A printable handwritten letter is a page you print, fold, and put in an envelope. This page fills one short note for each person on your list, using their name, and lays out a matching envelope. English pages use US Letter and a #10 envelope. Other languages use A4 and a DL envelope. The note itself can be edited. Type each person under the fixed headings, or import the Excel template. The font, the ink color, and the paper can be changed, and the letter can use a picture as its background.

The letters are set in a handwriting font. They are not written with a pen, and this site does not print, stamp, or mail them. If a row includes a note, that text is used instead of the note in the box.
